dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I live in the countryside. I visit the city once a year at this time to burn incense as an offering to the Geo Lord.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Everyone in Liyue is into things that bring good luck. I'm no different.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Were it not for the Geo Lord's power, Liyue would not be as prosperous as it is today. That is why I come here every year to pay my respects at this temple, no matter how long the journey is and no matter what other pressing business there is to attend to.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: As the saying goes, "None shall learn what the immortals have in store for them until he first does that which is within his power as a mortal."

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Huh. Judging from your tone, you're not a believer, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Well, just a short while back, I was set upon by bandits on the road to Liyue Harbor. It was only by the intervention of a young hero named "Xingqiu of the Guhua Clan" that I was saved.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: This must have been the protection of Rex Lapis! He must have known that I was coming to offer incense, and thus stepped in to rescue me!

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Were it not for Rex Lapis' divine arrangement, how could a long-lost clan like Guhua suddenly return out of nowhere?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: However you want to put it, I thank Rex Lapis. I shall also offer incense on behalf of that young hero of the Guhua Clan. I will pray for his fortune and safety, as repayment for his deeds.
